profile.description: Gemma 4 models are designed to deliver frontier-level performance at each size, targeting deployment scenarios on consumer GPUs and workstations. They are well-suited for reasoning, agentic workflows, coding, and multimodal understanding. Gemma 4 features a context window of up to 256K tokens and maintains multilingual support in over 140 languages.
